entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Midnight. I was in the living room..."
entries.dialogueText: Midnight. I was in the living room watching the tail end of a news report when I heard the phone ring.

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“Hello. Anton?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Hello. Anton?”

entries.dialogueText: I sighed and walked over to the phone, wondering who could be calling me this late.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I picked it up."
entries.dialogueText: I picked it up.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Hello. Who is this?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Hello. Who is this?”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.menuText: “Don't you know what time it is?”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“This is Evelyn.”"
entries.dialogueText: “This is Evelyn.”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“Sorry for calling so late.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sorry for calling so late.”

entries.title: Player: "“If you wanted to talk to Monica, s..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you wanted to talk to Monica, she's sleeping right now.”
entries.menuText: “If you wanted to talk to Monica, she's sleeping right now.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Is something wrong?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Is something wrong?”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“Actually, I was calling for you.""
entries.dialogueText: “Actually, I was calling for you."

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“Yes. No. I don't know, actually.""

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Can't this wait until the morning?..."
entries.dialogueText: “Can't this wait until the morning?”

entries.dialogueText: “Spit it out, woman. What's going on?”
entries.menuText: “Spit it out, woman. What's going on?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All right. Let's talk.”"
entries.dialogueText: "All right. Let's talk.”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“I don't think it can. I didn't kno..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't think it can. I didn't know who to call.”

entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“The thing is, I was supposed to me..."
entries.dialogueText: “The thing is, I was supposed to meet with Petr today to hand him the signed divorce papers.”

entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“But he didn't come to our designat..."
entries.dialogueText: “But he didn't come to our designated meeting point. I figured he might have been too drunk to remember, so I went to the apartment he's been renting -- but he wasn't there either."

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“I asked around. The landlord, the..."
entries.dialogueText: “I asked around. The landlord, the neighbors, his friends...”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“No one knows where he is.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No one knows where he is.”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“Trust me, Anton, I couldn't be mor..."
entries.dialogueText: “Trust me, Anton, I couldn't be more excited to be rid of this man. But I can't close off this chapter of my life without his cooperation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm sure he'll turn up.""
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sure he'll turn up."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Get some sleep, Evelyn.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Get some sleep, Evelyn.”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“Goodbye.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Goodbye.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The line dropped."
entries.dialogueText: The line dropped.

entries.dialogueText: As I put down the phone, Monica sleepily approached with a glass of water in her hand.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's fine. Go back to bed.""

entries.speaker: Player

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.dialogueText: I continued to watch TV.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “Petr. Petr Vectern. The ex-Vice President.”

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“As you command. I will report my f..."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Have a good night.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Have a good night.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for your help. As always.""

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very well. I will be waiting.”"
